cause_quote: The new replaceable-request branch returned `flooded ?? skippedFloodResponse(waitMs, "flood wait active")`, handing the existing API logger a synthetic 429 when the limiter deliberately skipped a typing update.
user_saw: Gateway operators saw an ERROR for each Telegram typing update the account limiter deliberately skipped during an active flood wait.
summary: The fix marks deliberately skipped Telegram typing and preview updates so the API logger suppresses those errors while still logging real API failures and undeliverable final replies.
reasoning: The introducing diff added both the account-wide flood gate and the synthetic 429 for updates it held back. I checked the parent’s typing path and API logger, which already logged thrown errors, so the misleading ERROR was present from the introduction of the new skip path.
